summary: Sala Sudasiri Sobha is a small concert hall in the Lat Phrao area, hosting classical and chamber recitals, mixed-genre performances and educational events. Its intimate scale and musician-designed acoustics make it an appealing evening outing when a suitable performance is scheduled; it is not a walk-in attraction with guaranteed daily programming.
whyGo: Hear live music in a purpose-built hall seating roughly 180–200, with an opportunity at some concert-series events to meet performers and other audience members afterward.
The official concert series includes Thai and international artists and states that light food and drinks are included after concerts without an additional charge.
bestFor: Classical music, piano, chamber music and intimate live-performance fans.
Travellers willing to plan a Bangkok evening around a specific listing rather than a fixed attraction schedule.
skipIf: You need a confirmed December 2026 event before building the itinerary; the calendar checked on 17 October shows listings only through 7 November.
You need published step-free access details or a predictable daily opening schedule.
duration: Allow around 2–3 hours for a performance and any post-concert reception; this is a planning estimate, as show length varies by event.
cost: Ticket prices vary by performance and were not confirmed for December 2026. A past bundle offer lists four tickets for THB 4,000, but this is not a reliable estimate of single-ticket prices. Check the individual event listing before budgeting.
hours: There is no general visitor schedule: attend at the time stated for a booked concert or event. The venue's traditional concert series is titled ‘Sunday 4 O'Clock,’ but confirm the actual date and start time on each listing.
bestTime: Choose a performance that matches your musical interests; Sunday-afternoon concerts may fit easily into an evening plan, but the programme and times vary. Arrive with enough time to find the venue in the lane before the event starts.
gettingThere: The official address is 158/20 Lat Phrao 41 Yaek 7-2, Chatuchak, Bangkok. The venue identifies Phawana MRT Yellow Line station as a nearby transit reference. From there, allow time for the final local journey by taxi or ride-hail and verify the route on the day. On-site parking is listed for about 20 cars at the end of the alley.
booking: Check the official Upcoming Events calendar and open the individual event page for ticket availability, price and booking instructions. For reservations or access questions, contact +66 63 358 4005 or contact@SalaSudasiriSobha.com. No December 2026 event was visible in the calendar checked on 17 October 2026.
accessibility: The official site does not describe wheelchair access, lifts, accessible toilets or seating arrangements. Contact the venue before booking to confirm the route and facilities required; the hall includes balcony seating, but access to each level is not documented.
practicalTips: Check the live calendar close to your trip; the page is event-based and its listings change over time.
Confirm the precise entrance, start time, ticket price and whether refreshments are included for the particular concert.

The venue says its concert series supports the Gift of Life Foundation and offers a light meal and beverages after these concerts without extra charge; confirm whether a specific event follows this format.
Allow time for the narrow local-lane approach. Official visitor details mention parking at the end of the alley, but concert parking availability is not guaranteed.
decemberNotes: No December 2026 performance or holiday opening schedule was confirmed in the official calendar checked on 17 October 2026; the visible upcoming listings end in early November. Recheck the venue calendar or contact the hall nearer the trip, and plan around a confirmed event. Bangkok traffic can make the last leg slow, so leave a buffer; this is general planning advice.
uncertainties: December 2026 programme, ticket prices and event-specific booking terms are not yet confirmed in the sources reviewed.
Accessibility details and concert-day parking arrangements are not published on the official visitor information reviewed.
